articles.title: Indian IT stocks Infosys, Wipro, TCS see modest losses after IBM's worst day since 1968
articles.description: In response to IBM's fall, the US-listed shares of Indian IT services companies (ADRs), Infosys and Wipro, fell 4% and 3% respectively. Shares of other software-oriented companies, Accenture, Salesforce, Microsoft, Cognizant, Autodesk, also declined between 1.5% to 3%.
articles.content:
The Nifty IT index is the second-best sectoral gainer so far in the month of July with a 9% advance. Shares of Infosys, HCLTech and TCS are all up between 8% and 9% so far in July, while those of Tech Mahindra and Wipro are up between 4% to 6%.
